newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian shares end mixed, trade sees nervous market.
newsitem.headline: Russian shares end mixed, trade sees nervous market.

text.p: Russian shares ended mixed on Friday, posting late-day gains after opening lower, but dealers said the market was nervous over its medium-term direction.
The Russian Trading System Index lost 1.58 percent to close at 181.75 on a robust $31.1 million in volume.
Mosenergo closed flat on Thursday's close at $0.99, Gazprom fell to $0.445 from $0.48, UES ticked up to $0.0805 after $0.0795 and Surgutneftegaz closed up at $0.405 after $0.390.
"This is not long-term growth -- there will be cheaper buys this winter," said Andrei Kukk of Rinaco Plus, referring to gains earlier this week.
Some traders said they saw growth over the medium-term -- but many expect a correction to follow.
"We will not be holding long positions," Kukk said, adding that prices could lose 8-15 percent from recent peaks.
Many traders say Yeltsin's heart bypass, expected in about two months, would put pressure on the market and lead to a dip that could coincide with investors taking end-of-year profits.
But Oleg Tatkov of Renaissance Capital said the market had reached a new trading range. "The factors which led to the market rise are now fixed in the prices," he said.
Tatkov said that buyers were ready to jump into the market whenever a chance opened up.
Traders said Monday could see some price pressure without support from the United States, where markets will be closed for the Columbus Day holiday.
